tools.name: get_spending_summary
tools.description: Get an aggregate spending total across a date range, grouped by category or merchant. For describing or summarizing a single expense the user already has open, use the expense data already provided instead — this tool is for totals across multiple transactions, not a narrative description of one.

tools.name: compare_periods
tools.description: Compare spending between two time periods.

tools.name: search_expenses
tools.description: Search for expenses by keyword (merchant or item name). Returns the actual purchased item names for each matching expense — use this to find out what products/groceries the user bought.

tools.name: get_top_merchants
tools.description: Get top merchants ranked by total spending.

tools.name: get_spending_trends
tools.description: Get spending trends over time (daily, weekly, or monthly).

tools.name: get_income_summary
tools.description: Get income summary for a date range. Returns total income amount and count of income entries.

tools.name: get_income_list
tools.description: List individual income entries with optional date filtering. Returns source, amount, date, and account per entry.

tools.name: get_balance_overview
tools.description: Get income vs expenses balance overview.

tools.name: get_recurring_payments
tools.description: Get recurring payments (subscriptions, bills, upcoming charges).

status.description: Filter by status (omit for all statuses)

tools.name: get_accounts
tools.description: Get all payment accounts (cash, cards, bank accounts) with balances.

tools.name: get_budget_status
tools.description: Get budget status and spending vs budget for a specific month.

budget.description: Monthly budget amount in user currency

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: Get all available expense categories — both system defaults and user-created custom categories. Returns code, name, description, color, and icon. Call this before reclassify_item if you do not already know a valid category code.

tools.name: get_expense_detail
tools.description: Get full details of a single expense by ID, including all line items with prices, quantities, and categories.

tools.name: get_top_products
tools.description: Get the top 5 most-purchased products/items ranked by total cost, with similar product names merged (e.g. "MANGO" and "MANGO FRESH" count as one). Use this — not search_expenses — when the user wants to know what they buy most, or for suggesting a recipe from frequently-bought ingredients.

tools.name: get_expenses
tools.description: List expenses with optional date, merchant, category, account, and text filters.

search.description: Search by merchant or item name
